cases.purpose: Compare key-query behavior with procps-ng 4.0.4: dotted-slash
cases.comparison: Compare status, stdout and stderr byte-for-byte; normalize only the Bash location prefix as in the historical case.
cases.script:
show_query() {
  "$@" > /tmp/t227-sysctl.out 2> /tmp/t227-sysctl.err
  local status=$?
  printf 'status=%s out=' "$status"
  /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|' < /tmp/t227-sysctl.out
  printf ' err='
  /usr/bin/sed -E 's/^[^:]*: line [0-9]+: //' /tmp/t227-sysctl.err | /usr/bin/tr '\n' '|'
  printf '\n'
}
show_query sysctl kernel.ostype kernel/ostype
